{{Top|leg|title=''Ronton's Anthology to Galactic Literature'', Vol. 2}}
'''''Ronton's Anthology to Galactic Literature'', Vol. 2''' was an anthology of literature published by [[Ronton]]. It contained selections from ''[[The Despotica]]'' as edited by [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] academic [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]].
